text_block_list.text:
Марузенски's performance at the Satsuki
Sho is
absolute perfection, and she
declares herself a
worthy athlete to
chase after.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Спешл Уик and Грасс Вандер, who
saw
Марузенски run, both vow to catch
up to her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Smiling in response, Марузенски says
that she'll
do her best to live up to their
expectations in the
Japanese Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
